description: This file defines the 'Session' class within the org.tensorflow package, responsible for managing the execution environment for TensorFlow computational graphs. It includes methods for creating, running, and managing sessions, as well as nested classes for running graphs and capturing execution results. The class interacts with native code through JNI to perform graph execution tasks.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Main class for managing TensorFlow graph execution sessions, handling resource management, execution of operations, and interoperation with native code via JNI.

classes.name: Session.Runner
classes.description: Inner class providing a fluent API for configuring and executing graph runs, including feeding inputs, fetching outputs, and running targets.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the session, blocking until all active runs are completed.

methods.name: runner
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Runner instance for executing graph operations.
